summary: Iter 5 brand-separation retest. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass (smoke confirms no regressions). Frontend: splash dark bg + logo-only fades correctly, sessionStorage prevents re-show on reload, Login has NO logo image and NO RTI text (signin-headline + signin-overline render), Dashboard + History headers render text-only brand-lockup with TM monogram (no Trip Monitor logo image, no RTI/Riverside Transport text), SessionWizard contains no RTI/no logo image, manifest.json clean. FinishExportDialog + History export use 'TripSheet_' prefix and 'Trip Sheet — ' subject and 'attached the trip sheet' body (verified by code read).

design_issues.screen: Multiple shadcn dialogs (continue-dialog, finish-dialog, paper preview, etc.)
issues: Persistent Radix a11y warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description / aria-describedby' — accessibility-only, no functional impact. Carryover from iter 2.

action_items: OPTIONAL/BORDERLINE: /app/frontend/src/data/constants.js still contains a carrier-code option { code: 'RTI', label: 'RTI' } in the carriers list. Per the strict mandate ('No RTI text anywhere in the visible UI'), this string surfaces as a selectable option inside the Trip Form's carrier dropdown. If the user wants ZERO RTI text in any in-app UI, rename the label (e.g., 'Riverside') or remove the entry. PaperSheet usage is unaffected since it renders its own RTI lockup.
OPTIONAL a11y: add DialogTitle/DialogDescription (or VisuallyHidden) to all DialogContent components to silence Radix warnings (deferred from iter 2).
